cues.title: Title theme
cues.when: Title screen before a run, and the settings screen reached from it
cues.prompt: Original instrumental title theme for a cosy clockwork wizard tower roguelike. Inviting, warm, wondrous and a little melancholy. A memorable original melody on felt piano answered by solo French horn, music-box and celesta glints, warm string pad, plucked harp arpeggios, a slow ticking clockwork pulse like a grandfather clock escapement, soft low cello. Approximately 76 BPM, D dorian, 4/4, eight-bar phrases that state the theme, then repeat it with fuller strings and brass. Lamplit analog room sound, gentle and intimate. No drums, no big build and no fade-out ending. Leave the upper midrange open for small brass and glass interface sounds.

cues.title: Exploring the floor
cues.when: Walking the floor between fights, in every room except a rest room
cues.prompt: Original instrumental exploration music for a cosy clockwork wizard tower. Warm, curious, unhurried and gently mysterious. Felt piano playing a sparse repeating motif, music-box and celesta glints, soft brass pad swells, plucked harp and pizzicato strings, a quiet ticking clockwork percussion pattern like a distant escapement, warm low cello drone. Approximately 72 BPM, D dorian, steady four-bar phrases that repeat with small variations. Intimate warm room sound, lamplit and analog. No big build, no climax and no fade-out ending. Leave the upper midrange open for small brass and glass sound effects.

cues.title: Regular fight
cues.when: A regular fight, from the combat table unfolding until it folds away
cues.prompt: Original instrumental combat music for a clockwork brass automaton duel in a wizard tower. Tense, driving and mechanical but readable. Pulsing low strings ostinato, muted brass stabs, ticking and clanking metallic percussion like gears, soft war-drum pulse on a steady half-time groove, harpsichord and plucked harp counter-line, low cello and bass clarinet. Approximately 108 BPM, D minor, steady eight-bar phrases with constant energy. Warm brass and walnut room sound, dry and focused. No breakdown to silence, no fade-out ending and no solo drum fills. Leave the upper midrange open for card, dice and impact sound effects.

cues.title: Defeat lament
cues.when: Death screen after a lost fight, until the player returns to the title
cues.prompt: Original instrumental short lament for the end of a failed climb in a clockwork wizard tower. Sorrowful, gentle and reflective, not horror. Opens softly on a held low chord, then a solo cello melody over slow felt piano, a music box that winds down and slows, a soft string pad, and a final distant low clock chime. Approximately 66 BPM, slowing at the end, D minor, 4/4. A complete short piece of about 45 seconds with a clear ending on a sustained low D minor chord that rings out naturally to silence. Intimate warm room sound.

cues.title: Victory
cues.when: Victory screen after the guardian falls, until the player returns to the title
cues.prompt: Original instrumental victory music for reaching the top of a clockwork wizard tower after defeating its guardian. Triumphant, warm, relieved and wondrous. Opens softly on a held chord for two seconds, then a bright brass fanfare on an original melody, celebratory tolling bells, sweeping strings, rippling harp and celesta, timpani rolls, then a calm warm coda on felt piano and music box. Approximately 92 BPM, D major, 4/4. A complete short piece of about 60 seconds with a clear ending on a sustained D major chord that rings out naturally to silence. Lamplit warm hall sound.
